name: Crate
blurb: A plain knocked-together packing crate with no maker's stencil on it. Re-crating stolen goods needs one per load.

name: Barrel
blurb: A tight oak barrel off the cooperage: for salting fish and casking whiskey.

name: False-light rig
blurb: A lantern on a pole with a pane of colored glass, to show a light where no light should be. For luring a ship onto the rocks; wrecking comes later.
